name: @training/api
description: 神首公主购陪练 API 的 G1 本地骨架。

scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @training/worker run build && corepack pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test-dist/test/**/*.test.js && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test-dist/test/**/*.e2e-spec.js && node --test test/database/migrations.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm --filter @training/worker run build && corepack pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test-dist/test/**/*.e2e-spec.js
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm --filter @training/worker run build && corepack pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test-dist/test/**/*.integration.js
scripts.migrate:up: corepack pnpm run build && node dist/database/migrate.js
scripts.migrate:down: corepack pnpm run build && node dist/database/migrate.js --down
